verdict.rationale: GitLab's docs claim agents can 'turn issues into merge requests, remediate vulnerabilities, and review code' and that security findings surface in MRs/IDEs, indicating an AI-driven remediation workflow tied to scanner results (SAST/SCA/Secret Detection/DAST). However, there is no detail on the scope of vulnerability types covered, accuracy/quality of auto-generated fixes, or independent/hands-on validation that fixes are correctly generated and applied. Missing for 10: independent verification of fix quality/success rate, specifics on which vulnerability classes are supported, and confirmation of the human-in-the-loop approval flow.
